d: Three world leaders walk into a room, and the internet immediately turns it into a GTA 6 mission! Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin's meeting at the APEC Summit in Shenzhen has sent social media into meme overdrive. From GTA 6 fan fiction to hilarious edits imagining the leaders shopping for countries like Greenland, Canada, Ukraine and Taiwan, the internet has officially taken diplomacy into its own hands. A serious geopolitical meeting? Apparently, not on the internet's watch! Hem Saroya tells you more.
